mentions.name: ImperiaQuiz
mentions.description: Online quiz game supporting 1 vs 1 vs 1 matches, with bot opponents when few players are online. Built with a Go backend and a React + Three.js frontend, it features over 20,000 questions generated with LLMs and hand-reviewed, and is a remake of the old ConQUIZtador game.
mentions.source_excerpt:
An online quiz game https://imperiaquiz.com/en (1 vs 1 vs 1) or bots when there're not many online players. Go backend, React + Three frontend and a ton of questions (no API used there, I used LLMs and hand-reviews on many to fill up over 20,000 questions)

A remake of the old ConQUIZtador game.
